status: Four validated candidates queued; optional wide model held; no scientific fits yet.
scope: CE7454 supplied-training-only scratch models, <=12.3M trainable parameters, one inference pass

sources.use: learned deep unpooled stem for weak residual evidence; steganalysis evidence, not CE7454 result
IBN normalization precedent, already useful locally
high-resolution final fine-tuning precedent; transfer to forensic crops is a hypothesis
data shortcuts limit architecture gains; original generators and pretrained backbone are ineligible
spatial statistics precedent only; proposed head uses diagonal variance, not full bilinear covariance

arms.name: srresnet
arms.role: learned thin deep front; late spatial integration; average head

arms.name: srresnet_stats
arms.role: same SR backbone with mean and standard deviation head; isolates head effect

arms.name: grip_nodown_stats
arms.role: same GRIP backbone with early/intermediate mean+std and deep mean; one head

optional: grip_nodown_ibna_stats supports local source-only checkpoint adaptation; no eligible parent currently located on this machine
existing_evidence: SR-ResNet was proposed but not run in research_20261015/W_steganalysis_architectures.md. This is a tested implementation of that direction, not a claim of a new literature invention.
main_risks: Extra residual front may remove useful evidence or overfit
Pooling variance can encode processing shortcuts
Internal test labels are estimates; selecting repeatedly on them cannot establish independent generalization

proposed_training.base_recipe: s119_scratch2v_e450_seed2/args.json (matched s27 recipe, change training seed to 0)
proposed_training.epochs: 450 preferred, else 300 or 200 based on measured slowest-arm runtime; fixed common schedule before any fit
proposed_training.final_stage: same-architecture fine-tune 40 epochs at 512 with crop-upscale; exact runtime must fit deadline before launch
proposed_training.data_order: New optional --data-seed makes the loader independent of model initialization; keep identical batch size and workers across arms. No weighted sampling in this study.

proposed_selection: freeze one endpoint and train-derived corruption suite before scoring; compare clean accuracy and equally weighted processed conditions. No fitting on inferred dev/test labels.
gpu_strategy: parallel independent single-GPU runs preserve source batch and BatchNorm behavior; do not naively split batch32 over 8 DDP ranks

covered: SR head ablation shares exact initial backbone

limitations: Not a full code audit; no GPU performance or accuracy improvement established. No scientific training launched.
seed_policy: One training seed (0), data/split seed42; no second-seed sweep. Other machines already run baseline seeds.
handoff_review: Source validation saturated; stats heads low-confidence; heavy augmentation preserved; no exact test-processing replay; comparison to matched control is not proof of beating stronger IBN/soup submission.

held_out_arms.name: srresnet_wide_stats
held_out_arms.role: final stage widened 512 to 536 channels; capacity ablation

held_out_reason: Optional srresnet_wide_stats failed one native256 AMP gradient check (relativeL2 .1672 > .15); not authorized to bypass numerical gate. Four core models passed both groups at both native resolutions.
